domains.synthetic_confirmatory: simulation with known ground truth; seeds from the confirm namespace (opened only through a sealed design after the freeze); qualifier SYNTHETIC; says nothing direct about real markets
domains.real_retrospective: consumed v0.5-v0.7 days; qualifier RETROSPECTIVE; capped at EXPLORATORY
domains.real_fresh: never-accessed holdout days declared fresh at the freeze; acquisition follows the registered probe rule; NOT_AVAILABLE when acquisition is blocked
domains.synthetic_holdout: sealed synthetic multi-axis holdout (unseen family, regimes and seeds; holdout namespace opened once)

H1.question: Adaptive calibration improves future predictive performance versus frozen calibration.
H1.estimator: per (drift scenario, seed): relative reduction in one-step negative predictive log-likelihood per bin over future windows, rolling (window 3) versus frozen (first 2 windows); same generator family (registered: state_dependent)
H1.endpoint: mean relative loss reduction (frozen - rolling) / frozen
H1.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if the family-adjusted lower confidence bound > 0 and the estimate >= threshold; FAILED if the upper bound < 0; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise
H1.failure_semantics: a fit that does not converge is retained as INVALID for that unit and counted in the report

H2.question: Regime-conditioned calibration improves future predictive performance versus global calibration.
H2.estimator: relative reduction in one-step predictive loss on future windows, per-regime fits (regime labels from the registered development labeler) versus one global fit, same family (registered: poisson) in persistent regime-switching truth worlds
H2.endpoint: mean relative loss reduction (global - regime) / global
H2.failure_semantics: regimes with too few development blocks fall back to the global fit (recorded)

H3.question: Dynamic model averaging improves posterior predictive performance versus the best single fixed generator.
H3.estimator: per-bin log score of dynamic model averaging (forgetting 0.99, six core families fitted on the training segment) minus that of the single family with the best log score on the selection segment, on future segments of truth sequences whose generating family changes between segments
H3.endpoint: mean relative log-score improvement (relative to the best single family's mean loss)
H3.failure_semantics: families whose fit fails are excluded from both arms (recorded)

H4.question: Simulation-based inference achieves acceptable synthetic parameter recovery under registered recovery benchmarks.
H4.estimator: ABC-SMC (registered budget) on truths drawn from the prior for poisson, hawkes and queue_reactive registered parameter subsets
H4.endpoint: per-parameter empirical coverage of the 90% credible interval and median absolute error relative to the prior width
H4.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if every parameter has coverage >= 0.80 with Wilson lower bound >= 0.60 and median relative error <= 0.15; FAILED if any parameter has Wilson upper bound < 0.80; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise
H4.failure_semantics: a truth whose simulation violates the event guard is rejected and redrawn under the seeded rule (recorded)

H5.question: Material model/parameter uncertainty remains after calibration and must be propagated into execution conclusions.
H5.estimator: variance decomposition of paired policy cost differences over the registered plausible world design (family x posterior sample x queue rule x latency x hidden liquidity) with common seeds
H5.endpoint: epistemic share of variance of the paired difference for registered pairs (twap-mpc, twap-adaptive_twap, twap-heuristic, twap-pov)
H5.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if for at least one registered pair the Bonferroni-adjusted lower bound of the epistemic share >= 0.25; FAILED if every pair's upper bound < 0.10; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise
H5.failure_semantics: INVALID episodes are retained and reported; a pair with any INVALID cell is reported INVALID

H6.question: Better execution-aware calibration is associated with lower downstream execution decision regret.
H6.estimator: Spearman correlation across (truth world, candidate calibration) pairs between the execution-aware calibration loss and the truth regret of the policy the candidate selects
H6.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if the adjusted lower bound > 0 and rho >= 0.2; FAILED if the upper bound < 0; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise
H6.failure_semantics: pairs with INVALID policy evaluations are dropped from the association and counted

H7.question: Completion-constrained execution materially improves actual completion without unacceptable economic-cost degradation.
H7.estimator: per member policy (pov, heuristic, adaptive_twap, mpc): completion rate and economic cost with the hard completion constraint minus without it, paired by world and seed
H7.status_rule: considered members: unconstrained completion < 0.95; ESTABLISHED if every considered member has completion increase >= 0.10 with adjusted lower bound > 0.05 and cost non-inferiority within 3.0 bps (adjusted one-sided upper bound < 3.0); FAILED if any considered member is inferior beyond the margin; NOT_EVALUABLE if no member is considered; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise
H7.failure_semantics: unpriceable residuals are reported and excluded only from optimization-cost summaries

H8.question: Robust execution reduces worst-case or tail regret across plausible worlds.
H8.estimator: candidate parametric schedules are selected on development seeds and the selection world set by the CVaR(0.8) criterion and by the nominal criterion; both are evaluated on confirm seeds in held-out plausible worlds
H8.endpoint: CVaR(0.8) over held-out worlds of world-mean regret: nominal-selected minus CVaR-selected (bps)
H8.sample_unit: held-out world (hierarchical bootstrap: worlds then seeds)
H8.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if the adjusted lower bound > 0 and the estimate >= 0.25 bps; FAILED if the upper bound < 0; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise (also NOT_ESTABLISHED, recorded, if both criteria select the same candidate)

H9.question: MPC or adaptive execution improves robustness over static baselines.
H9.estimator: members mpc, mpc_robust and the adaptive variant with the lowest development CVaR, each versus TWAP, in held-out plausible worlds with confirm seeds
H9.endpoint: CVaR(0.8) over worlds of world-mean economic cost: TWAP minus member (bps)
H9.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if at least one member (Holm over 3) has lower bound > 0 and estimate >= 0.25 bps; FAILED if every member's upper bound < 0; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise

H10.question: Regime-aware policy selection improves decision performance versus a single global policy.
H10.estimator: selectors trained on development cases (worlds with known regime labels), evaluated on confirm cases
H10.endpoint: mean regret of the global selector minus mean regret of the regime selector (bps)
H10.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if the adjusted lower bound > 0 and the estimate >= 0.1 bps; FAILED if the upper bound < 0; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise

H11.question: OOD-aware abstention reduces incorrect policy-selection decisions.
H11.estimator: regime selector with and without abstention (OOD threshold at 5% false-positive rate on in-distribution calibration cases, safe baseline TWAP) on confirm in-distribution and registered OOD cases
H11.endpoint: incorrect-decision rate (regret > 0.5 bps) without minus with abstention
H11.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if the adjusted lower bound > 0 and the estimate >= 0.05; FAILED if the upper bound < 0; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise

H12.question: Safe fallback prevents large degradation under registered OOD conditions.
H12.estimator: among registered OOD cases: rate of large degradation (regret > 2 bps) with abstention and fallback, and without
H12.endpoint: large-degradation rate with fallback (Wilson upper bound) and its reduction versus no fallback
H12.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if the adjusted Wilson upper bound of the with-fallback rate <= 0.10 and the reduction's lower bound >= 0; FAILED if the with-fallback rate's Wilson lower bound > 0.10; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise

H13.question: Synthetic execution rankings predict bounded historical ranking direction better than chance.
H13.estimator: pairwise direction accuracy of the plausible-world mean ranking on historical pairs that are determinate under the registered bound grid
H13.endpoint: accuracy on determinate pairs (exact binomial test versus 0.5)
H13.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if at least 5 pairs are determinate, accuracy >= 0.6 and the adjusted one-sided binomial p < alpha; FAILED if accuracy < 0.5 with the upper bound below 0.5; NOT_EVALUABLE if fewer than 5 determinate pairs; NOT_AVAILABLE if holdout data cannot be acquired
H13.evidence_level: confirmatory on fresh real data, else NOT_AVAILABLE; retrospective results EXPLORATORY
H13.failure_semantics: a window with invalid bins is excluded and listed

H14.question: Counterfactual historical bounds are sufficiently narrow to distinguish at least some policy pairs.
H14.estimator: bounds computed on strategy-free twin tapes of plausible worlds under the registered assumption grid; pair bound = range over assumptions of the mean paired difference, widened by bootstrap sampling uncertainty
H14.endpoint: number of registered policy pairs whose bound excludes zero; expected-value coverage of the bounding method for the involved policies
H14.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if at least one registered pair is determinate and the expected-value coverage check does not reject coverage for either policy of that pair; ASSUMPTION_DEPENDENT if determinate pairs exist only where coverage is rejected; NOT_ESTABLISHED if no pair is determinate
H14.failure_semantics: INVALID replays are retained and counted

H15.question: Policy conclusions transfer across fresh temporal periods.
H15.estimator: dominance stability and Kendall tau of bounded policy rankings between the selection day and the fresh temporal day
H15.endpoint: fraction of determinate pairs with the same direction in both periods
H15.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if at least 5 pairs are determinate in both and stability >= 0.8 with Wilson lower bound >= 0.5; FAILED if stability < 0.5; NOT_EVALUABLE if fewer than 5 pairs; NOT_AVAILABLE if data cannot be acquired
H15.evidence_level: confirmatory on fresh real data, else NOT_AVAILABLE

H16.question: Policy conclusions transfer across instruments.
H16.estimator: as H15, ETH selection day versus fresh BTC day
H16.evidence_level: confirmatory on fresh real data, else NOT_AVAILABLE

H17.question: Policy conclusions transfer across venues when data capability permits.
H17.estimator: as H15, Deribit BTC versus BitMEX XBTUSD on the fresh day
H17.evidence_level: confirmatory on fresh real data, else NOT_AVAILABLE

H18.question: Calibration half-life is finite and adaptive updating improves post-drift performance.
H18.estimator: (a) observable-fit half-life per gradual-drift scenario (registered fit; ESTIMATED or NOT_ESTABLISHED); (b) post-change relative loss reduction, rolling versus frozen, in windows after the change
H18.endpoint: (a) number of gradual scenarios with an ESTIMATED finite half-life; (b) mean post-change relative loss reduction
H18.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if (a) holds in at least 2 of the 2 gradual scenarios and (b) has adjusted lower bound > 0 and estimate >= 0.01; FAILED if (b)'s upper bound < 0; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise

H19.question: Conformal intervals achieve registered empirical coverage on untouched evaluation periods.
H19.estimator: split conformal 90% intervals for episode economic cost (predictor: plausible-world mean cost of the policy) calibrated on development seeds, evaluated on confirm seeds of the same worlds (exchangeable) and of registered stress worlds (shifted)
H19.endpoint: empirical coverage on the exchangeable evaluation (Wilson interval); shifted coverage reported separately
H19.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if the exchangeable coverage's Wilson lower bound >= 0.85; FAILED if its Wilson upper bound < 0.85; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise
H19.failure_semantics: infinite intervals (too few calibration points) are counted and reported

H20.question: At least one execution conclusion survives the final untouched multi-axis real holdout under the preregistered uncertainty and practical-significance criteria.
H20.estimator: every conclusion ESTABLISHED by H8/H9 (and, if evaluable, determinate in H13) re-tested on bounded replays of the final holdout days
H20.endpoint: number of carried conclusions with the same sign, a bound excluding zero and |effect| >= its threshold
H20.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if at least one carried conclusion survives; NOT_ESTABLISHED if none survives; NOT_EVALUABLE if no conclusion was carried; NOT_AVAILABLE if the holdout cannot be acquired
H20.evidence_level: confirmatory on fresh real data, else NOT_AVAILABLE

H21.question: At least one execution conclusion survives the sealed synthetic multi-axis holdout (unseen generator family, unseen regimes, unseen seeds).
H21.estimator: every conclusion ESTABLISHED by H8 or H9 re-tested in holdout worlds (ecology family with endogenous response and regime transition, parameters drawn from the registered holdout box) with holdout-namespace seeds
H21.endpoint: number of carried conclusions with the same sign, interval excluding zero and |effect| >= threshold
H21.status_rule: ESTABLISHED if at least one carried conclusion survives; NOT_ESTABLISHED if none survives; NOT_EVALUABLE if no conclusion was carried
